```{r setup, include=FALSE}

my_packs <- c("tidyverse", "haven", "here", "ggthemes", "cowplot", "patchwork")

for(i in my_packs) {
  
  library(i, character.only = T)
}

library(tidyverse)
library(ragg)
```


```{r}
data_init <- readxl::read_xlsx(here("data", "moud_initiation_v2.xlsx"), sheet = "any_moud")

moud_lvls <- data_init |>
  pull(moud) |>
  unique()

period_lvls <- data_init |>
  pull(initiation) |>
  unique()

data_init <- data_init |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  mutate(moud = factor(moud, levels = moud_lvls), 
         initiation = factor(initiation, levels = period_lvls), 
         strata = factor(ifelse(moud == "Any MOUD", 0, 1), 
                         labels = c("Timing of first observed MOUD", "Medication distribution by timing of first observed MOUD")))

plot_1 <- data_init |>
  mutate(moud = factor(moud, levels = moud_lvls)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = initiation, y = prop, fill = moud)) +
  geom_col(position = position_stack()) +
  cowplot::theme_half_open() + 
  ggsci::scale_fill_jama() +
  labs(y = "%", x = "") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
        legend.title = element_blank(), 
        text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman"), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, 
                                   vjust = 1, 
                                   hjust = 1)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2)) +
  facet_wrap(~strata, 
             scales = "free_y", 
             labeller = as_labeller(c("Timing of first observed MOUD" = "A. Timing of first observed MOUD", "Medication distribution by timing of first observed MOUD" = "B. Medication distribution by timing of first observed \nMOUD"))) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.12, 0.12))) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 10),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.03))) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100)) 
  # labs(title = "Timing of first observed MOUD and MOUD distribution among pregnancies using \nMOUD (n= 121,433).")

ggsave(plot = plot_1, here("plot_1v3.jpeg"), device = ragg::agg_jpeg,, 
       width = 9, height = 6, units = "in", dpi = 1800)

```

```{r}
data_init_year <- readxl::read_xlsx(here("data", "moud_initiation_year.xlsx"), sheet = "Sheet1")

yr_lvls <- data_init_year |>
  pull(year) |>
  unique()

data_init_year <- data_init_year |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  mutate(moud = factor(moud, levels = moud_lvls), 
         initiation = factor(initiation, levels = period_lvls))

base_plot <- data_init_year |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = prop,vgroup = moud, color = moud)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(alpha = 1) +
  cowplot::theme_half_open() +
  ggsci::scale_color_jama(name = NULL, limits = moud_lvls, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_linetype_discrete(name = NULL, limits = moud_lvls, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2016:2020) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 60, by = 10),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.03))) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 60)) +
  facet_wrap(~initiation) +
  labs(y = "%", x = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman")) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 1), linetype = guide_legend(ncol = 1))

plot2_1 <- base_plot + 
  filter(data_init_year, initiation == "Pre-pregnancy")

plot2_2 <- base_plot +
  filter(data_init_year, initiation == "1st trimester")

plot2_3 <- base_plot +
  filter(data_init_year, initiation == "2nd trimester")

plot2_4 <- base_plot +
  filter(data_init_year, initiation == "3rd trimester")

plot2_5 <- base_plot +
  filter(data_init_year, initiation == "Postpartum")


plot_year <- wrap_plots(plot2_1, plot2_2,
                        plot2_3, plot2_4, 
                        plot2_5, guide_area(), 
                        ncol = 2, guides = "collect")

ggsave(plot = plot_year, here("plot_2.jpeg"), device = ragg::agg_jpeg,, 
       width = 8, height = 9, units = "in", dpi = 1800)
```

```{r}
data_plot <- readxl::read_xlsx(here("data/", "moud_plot.xlsx"))

var_lvls <- data_plot |>
  pull(var) |>
  unique()

term_lvls <- data_plot |>
  pull(term) |>
  unique()

moud_lvls <- data_plot |>
  pull(moud) |>
  unique()

moud_cols <- c("Buprenorphine/Naloxone" = "#DF8F44FF",
               "Buprenorphine" = "#00A1D5FF",
               "Naltrexone" = "#B24745FF",
               "Methadone" = "#79AF97FF")

plot_3 <- data_plot |>
  mutate(orden = seq(1, length(var), 1), 
         moud = factor(moud, levels = moud_lvls)) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = reorder(term, desc(orden)), x = rr, xmin = ll_ci,
             xmax = ul_ci, color = moud)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
             size = 3.5, shape = 18) +
  geom_errorbar(position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
                width = 0.12) +
  facet_grid(var ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", 
             switch = "y") +
  labs(x = "RR", y = NULL, color = NULL) +
  cowplot::theme_half_open() +
  theme(strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom", 
    strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 90, face = "bold",
                                     size = 14)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, color = "gray60") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 2)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = moud_cols) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1, 2.5, 5, 7.5, 10), 
                     limits = c(0, 10), 
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.005, 0.03)))

ggsave(plot = plot_3, here("plot_2.jpeg"), device = "jpeg", 
       width = 8, height = 9, units = "in", dpi = 1800)



```
